Chief_Complaint.content: Rapidly progressive upper lip swelling after prawn soup
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Rapidly progressive upper lip swelling after prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Lip tingling and swelling began about 30 minutes after eating prawn soup
Lip swelling started at the left corner of the lip
Patient describes a 'pumping' sensation in the upper lip
Patient is unsure if chest feels tight and states it 'might be'
Approximately one year ago patient had a similar episode after late-night Chinese or curry food
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Prior similar: ~1 yr ago after late-night Chinese/curry

History_of_Present_Illness.content: During prior similar episode, patient woke the next morning quite swollen
During prior similar episode, patient had difficult breathing
Patient sometimes uses antihistamines but is unsure which one
Patient had no antihistamines on hand initially during current episode
Patient was initially alone during the episode and is now accompanied by her mother

Medications.content: Patient does not use a 'brown' inhaler

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: As a child, patient received an injection and hospital treatment for peanut allergy per mother
Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: had injection/hospital as a child per mum

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient's mother is present with the patient

Assessment.content: Suspected anaphylactic reaction after prawn ingestion
Assessment.source_text: Suspected anaphylactic reaction after prawn ingestion

Assessment.content: Anaphylaxis suspicion is based on rapid-onset progressive lip swelling, breathing difficulty, dizziness, history of peanut allergy, and prior similar episode
Assessment.source_text: rapid-onset progressive lip swelling, breathing difficulty, dizziness; hx peanut allergy; prior similar episode

Plan_of_Care.content: Call emergency services (999) immediately for suspected anaphylaxis
Patient's mother to call emergency services and stay with the patient
Plan_of_Care.source_text: mother to call and stay with pt

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to take an antihistamine now if available while awaiting ambulance
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Take antihistamine now (if available) while awaiting ambulance

Plan_of_Care.content: Urgent emergency department assessment is planned
After discharge, patient should contact clinic for epinephrine autoinjector and allergy plan
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Post-discharge: contact clinic for epinephrine autoinjector and allergy plan

Plan_of_Care.content: Continue salbutamol inhaler as needed for asthma
Review need for asthma controller therapy at follow-up

Follow_up_Information.content: Post-discharge follow-up with clinic for epinephrine autoinjector and allergy plan is advised
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Post-discharge: contact clinic for epinephrine autoinjector and allergy plan

Follow_up_Information.content: Asthma controller therapy to be reviewed at follow-up
